items.en: I am convinced that most people have good intentions.
items.zh: 我相信大多数人都怀有善意。

items.en: You can’t rely on anyone these days.
In general, people can be trusted.
items.zh: 总的来说，人们是可以信任的。

instructions.en: In the following we are interested in your attitude towards other people. Please indicate the extent to which you agree or disagree with each of the statements below.
instructions.zh: 下面我们想了解你对其他人的看法。请指出你对以下每句话的同意或不同意程度。
